# Puerto Plata Cruise Excursions

> Puerto Plata shore excursions for cruise passengers: Damajagua waterfalls, City Tour, horseback riding, buggies, a Playa Dorada beach day and a private catamaran or yacht. Pickup at the port. Book on WhatsApp.

- Website: https://popcruiseexcursions.com/
- WhatsApp: +1 (829) 627-7733 (https://wa.me/18296277733)
- Email: popcruiseexcursions@gmail.com
- Location: Puerto Plata, Dominican Republic

## Tours

Prices in US dollars. Per-person prices depend on the size of the group.

- [Damajagua Waterfalls](https://popcruiseexcursions.com/#tour-damajagua): Jump, swim and slide down the most famous natural waterfalls on the north coast. Add the zipline and fly over the jungle. From US$50.
  - 1 to 5 people: US$100 with zipline, US$75 no zipline
  - 6 to 14 people: US$80 with zipline, US$65 no zipline
  - 15 to 50 people: US$70 with zipline, US$50 no zipline
- [Puerto Plata City Tour](https://popcruiseexcursions.com/#tour-city): See the best of the city with a guide, then wrap up with free time at Playa Dorada. From US$12.
  - 1 to 5 people: US$20 per person
  - 6 to 14 people: US$15 per person
  - 15 to 50 people: US$12 per person
- [Horseback riding](https://popcruiseexcursions.com/#tour-horse): An hour and a half on horseback along the beach and through the Puerto Plata countryside. From US$60.
  - 1 to 5 people: US$70 per person
  - 6 to 14 people: US$65 per person
  - 15 to 50 people: US$60 per person
- [Buggies & ATVs](https://popcruiseexcursions.com/#tour-buggy): Drive down dirt roads, through mud puddles and plantations. Get ready to get dirty — it’s part of the fun. Price on request (depends on group size).
- [Playa Dorada Beach Day](https://popcruiseexcursions.com/#tour-beach): A worry-free day at the beach: we take you straight to Playa Dorada, with umbrellas and loungers reserved for your group, and bring you back to the port with plenty of time to spare. From US$15.
  - 1 to 5 people: US$30 per person
  - 6 to 14 people: US$25 per person
  - 15 to 50 people: US$15 per person
- [Private catamaran or yacht](https://popcruiseexcursions.com/#tour-catamaran): Charter the whole boat just for your group and sail the Puerto Plata coast. Choose from 4 catamarans and 2 yachts. From US$900.
  - Viking 48': US$900 for the whole boat (up to 15 people), +US$30 per extra person; US$400 deposit to book
  - Yacht with jacuzzi: US$950 for the whole boat (up to 15 people), +US$40 per extra person; US$400 deposit to book
  - Fountaine Pajot 43': US$1,100 for the whole boat (up to 15 people), +US$25 per extra person; US$400 deposit to book
  - The Ocean King IV: US$1,000 for the whole boat (up to 15 people), +US$45 per extra person; US$400 deposit to book
  - Libreterre · Privilege 52': US$1,250 for the whole boat (up to 20 people), +US$25 per extra person; US$550 deposit to book
  - Catamaran with jacuzzi: US$1,300 for the whole boat (up to 15 people), +US$30 per extra person; US$700 deposit to book

## Booking and policies

### Where do the tours start?

We pick you up at the Puerto Plata cruise port and bring you back when the tour ends. Round-trip transport is included, except for catamarans and yachts: they leave from Sosúa beach, 45 minutes from Amber Cove port and 30 minutes from Taino Bay, and we’ll quote that transport separately on WhatsApp or by email.

### Will I make it back to my ship on time?

We plan every tour around your ship’s departure time. When you book, tell us your ship’s name and your all-aboard time.

### How do group prices work?

The price per person depends on how many of you travel together: 1 to 5, 6 to 14 or 15 to 50 people. The bigger the group, the less each person pays. Catamarans and yachts work differently: you charter the whole boat for a flat price for up to 15 or 20 people, depending on the boat, and each additional person costs extra.

### What’s included in the Damajagua Waterfalls tour?

Round-trip transport, water along the way and a buffet lunch at the waterfalls’ restaurant. The zipline is optional.

### Is lunch included in the City Tour?

No. At the end of the tour you get free time at Playa Dorada, where you can have lunch at one of the beachfront restaurants if you like. Lunch and extra drinks are not included.

### What language are the tours in?

English and Spanish. Message us on WhatsApp in whichever you prefer.

### What is your cancellation policy?

Cancel 10 or more days before your tour and we refund 100% of what you paid; with less than 10 days’ notice, we refund 50%. If your cruise ship doesn’t reach Puerto Plata, we refund 90%.
